run_poker_fcpa_game: run the poker fcpa example game with random agents and a fixed seed
load_agent_by_type: load a poker agent by type such as random, human, check_call, or fold
create_fcpa_game: create a heads-up no-limit poker game using the fcpa game string
simulate_game_rounds: simulate poker game rounds through chance and decision nodes until terminal
get_game_utilities: get the final utility returns for each player after the game ends
